steps.note: the real P27 score on THIS mixer's music bus, then a scripted fight over it

steps.msg: battle theme is playing through the mixer

steps.note: the plain hit: 1 ms snap, a low 'dosh' body that fills the bass the music dip takes away, then a swish that sweeps dark and is out of the way inside ~100 ms

steps.msg: a hit dips the live music bus under its snap and recovers by itself

steps.note: the cursor is the one sound a child rattles: in DQV you run down the item list and the strings stay rock steady

steps.msg: the cursor pip does NOT move the music (it used to dip it 3 dB per press — a wobble on the score at scroll speed)
rattling the cursor down and up the list leaves the music bus untouched
the meadow bed is playing as a chain of crossfaded variants
Esc mid-line releases the dialogue duck
every effect renders: audible, not clipping, no NaN, one-shots end, loops seamless

every impact: snap 1-3 ms in and >= 7 dB over its body, body -10 dB within 45 ms, lifts the battle mix 4.5-8 LU (crit <= 10), ADDS >= 6 dB at 60-250 Hz 30 ms after contact (it used to take 3-4 dB away), the three impacts have different envelopes (r <= 0.9) — and NOTHING LINGERS at 3-6 kHz: out of the music's way by 60 ms, gone by 150, and a connected hit ends up >= 10 dB darker than a swing at thin air (the plain hit used to hold +16.5 LU over the theme there at 150 ms)
